subject: Streamline Inference Adapter — proposal & next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Avery Cloud <avery@streamline.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@streamline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Streamline Inference Adapter — proposal & next steps

Thanks for a productive call earlier — appreciate the candid product detail and the demo of the triage flow. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we're all aligned.

Key pain you shared
- Current embedding search returns noisy matches for short symptom queries; precision drops for <30-token queries.
- Production latency spikes when re-ranking large candidate sets; batching is manual and causes tail latency.
- Need structured outputs (JSON schema) for downstream triage automation.

What we proposed on the call
- Embedding + rerank: generate dense embeddings at ingest, then lightweight rerank on top of streaming candidate scores to keep latency <120ms p50.
- Streaming + function-calling: stream partial answers while simultaneously emitting structured fields via function calls so your triage pipeline can act early.
- SDK adaptors: small client-side changes (two callbacks: onPartialToken, onStructuredEmit) + option to enable prefix/KV caching on the server side.

Action items (owner — due)
- Redwood: deliver a concise pilot proposal with scope, success metrics, and price (Diego) — EOD Tue 2026-11-02.
- Streamline: share sample dataset (anonymized) + 2 sample short queries that fail today (Avery) — Wed 2026-11-03.
- Redwood infra: prepare a small test endpoint with streaming & function-call hooks for pilot (Ben) — Thu 2026-11-04.
- Both: confirm legal/PO path for a 6-week pilot (Samir/Avery) — Thu 2026-11-04.

Attachments: RD-4379-proposal.pdf (outline + pilot pricing), demo-recording.mp4 (recording of today's session).

If that matches your read, I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff once we get the dataset.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Avery Cloud <avery@streamline.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@streamline.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Streamline Inference Adapter — proposal & next steps

Diego — thanks, this is helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications and requests: 

1) Dataset: we'll drop a sanitized export (5000 short queries + ground-truth rerank labels) into the S3 link you provided. Expect that by COB Tues.
2) Success metrics: can you include sample telemetry events we should expect from streaming (tokens emitted, early-function triggers) so our infra team can verify integration?
3) Pilot infra: for the test endpoint, do you support a stable model pin (we need determinism for evaluation) + an automatic fallback to a lower-cost quantized variant?

High level timeline we're aiming for: pilot kickoff 11/09, 6-week pilot, followed by evaluation and procurement in December. Pricing is negotiable but we need a clear escalation path if latency or precision goals aren’t met.

Also: legal will want SOC2 evidence and an initial data processing addendum. Who should I loop in on your side?

Avery Cloud
Head of Product, Streamline AI
avery@streamline.ai | +1 212-555-0147

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Avery Cloud <avery@streamline.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Streamline Inference Adapter — proposal & next steps

Adding a couple notes on pricing & pilot options so it's on record: 

Pilot flavors (estimates)
- PoC sandbox (no SLA): $0 for infra + $0.05/1k tokens consumed during test window. Good for feature validation only.
- Paid pilot (6 weeks, reserved capacity): $4,500/week reserved + $0.02/1k tokens; includes a single model pin and a guaranteed baseline throughput. We can add ramp credits if you hit production traffic.
- Dedicated pilot (if you want predictable latency): monthly reserved plan — we'll share numbers in the proposal PDF.

Model pin & fallback
- Yes: we can pin to a specific model version for deterministic outputs. Automatic fallback to a compatible quantized model is supported; we surface mismatch alerts in the console and can set an automatic rollback policy.

Telemetry & observability
- We'll include sample metrics (streaming token latency, function-call events, rerank score distribution) in the proposal. Those map directly to alerts you can enable in the Redwood Console.

I'll sync with Diego to fold pricing into the proposal this afternoon.

—Ben

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Two operational asks before we sign off on a paid pilot: 

1) SOC 2 / security artifacts: can you share a SOC 2 report or a link to your compliance pack? (Neha, can you advise)
2) Data retention and deletion: we need a clear retention window and the ability to purge pilot data on demand. Please confirm if pilot data will be isolated per account.

If those are OK, we'll route an internal PO for the paid pilot option. Also please include a sample SLA for p50/p95 token latency in the proposal.

Samir — thanks, all good. Quick answers and links: 

- SOC 2: we host an internal redacted SOC 2 and compliance pack here: https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/compliance/RD-SOC2-redacted-2026.pdf (password-protected, we'll share credentials via a secure link). Neha will be the primary contact for any deeper security questionnaires.
- Data isolation & retention: pilot datasets are isolated per account, stored in encrypted volumes. Standard pilot retention is 90 days; early purge on request supported via the Console Data Controls or by opening a support ticket (we'll honor deletion within 48 hours of request for pilot data).
- SLA: proposal PDF includes p50/p95 token latency targets for the reserved pilot tier; Ben will include numeric targets in the pricing appendix.

Next steps I’ll take now: finalize the PDF (RD-4379-proposal.pdf) with the pricing table Ben proposed, include the telemetry examples Avery requested, and upload a DocuSign for the pilot SOW. I’ll share the DocuSign link once uploaded.
